stories.headline: Abu Dhabi consolidates ADQ into new L'IMAD sovereign investment vehicle
stories.summary: The UAE government announced a major restructuring of Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth architecture, consolidating the $263 billion ADQ fund into the newly formed L'IMAD Holding Company under Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The consolidation creates a new investment powerhouse managing hundreds of billions in state assets.

stories.headline: Saudi-UAE tensions escalate into public diplomatic rift

stories.headline: Central Bank of UAE maintains interest rates at 3.65%
stories.summary: The Central Bank of the UAE decided to hold the base rate applicable to the Overnight Deposit Facility steady at 3.65%, following the US Federal Reserve's decision to maintain rates unchanged. This was the first interest rate decision of 2026.

stories.headline: GCC launches joint military exercise including UAE participation
stories.summary: Qatar launched the 'Arabian Gulf Security 4' joint military exercise involving UAE security forces, GCC countries, and US special units. The exercise runs until February 4 and includes 114 teams from 48 countries implementing over 70 field scenarios.

stories.headline: UAE concludes 10-year military mission in Yemen
stories.summary: The UAE concluded its decade-long military engagement in Yemen, transitioning from military operations to humanitarian impact. Emirati forces were involved in liberation operations, counterterrorism missions, and humanitarian relief efforts as part of Operation Decisive Storm since March 2015.
